script.title: XML vs JSON: A Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Hello there! Today, we're going to explore two popular data formats: XML and JSON. Let’s dive in!
scenes.visualDirection: Show a simple record of information about a book.

scenes.narration:
Imagine you have this little piece of information about a book:

<book>
	<title>Harry Potter</title>
	<author>J.K. Rowling</author>
	<publisher>Harry Potter Publishing Co.</publisher>
</book>
scenes.visualDirection: Display the XML representation of the book record on screen.
Show the JSON representation of the same information next to the XML one.

candidate.explanation: Introduce the topic with an engaging example.
